description: Instantiated evaluation queries with ground truth annotations based on captured ambient context database.

categories.name: Pure Temporal
categories.description: Queries with time-only constraints, testing temporal filtering without relying on semantic embedding.

queries.query: What was I doing at 9:50 PM on November 23?

ground_truth.expected_answer: Used Snipping Tool overlay, previewed Agent_Context.md in Antigravity IDE, and checked WhatsApp in Chrome.

queries.query: What apps did I use between 9:40 PM and 10:00 PM on November 23?

ground_truth.expected_answer: Antigravity IDE, Google Chrome, and Snipping Tool.

queries.query: What was I doing between 9:42 PM and 9:46 PM on November 23?

ground_truth.expected_answer: Edited requirements.txt in Antigravity IDE, then browsed Claude and Google Search in Chrome.

queries.query: How long did I spend on Chrome between 9:40 PM and 9:50 PM on November 23?

ground_truth.expected_answer: Active in Chrome across Claude and Google Search from 21:42 to 21:47 (~5 minutes).

queries.query: What was the last thing I was doing on November 23?

ground_truth.expected_answer: Configuring Antigravity Settings in Antigravity IDE.

queries.query: When did I start working on November 23?

ground_truth.expected_answer: First capture recorded at 9:42 PM in Antigravity IDE on requirements.txt.

categories.name: Pure Semantic
categories.description: Queries with content-only constraints, testing retrieval precision and keyword/semantic matching.

queries.query: Find captures where requirements.txt was open in the editor

ground_truth.expected_answer: Captures 15-18, 36, 43 viewing requirements.txt in Antigravity IDE.

queries.query: Where did I see the word 'WhatsApp'?

ground_truth.expected_answer: In Chrome window titled WhatsApp - Google Chrome.

queries.query: What was I reading about major project thesis?

ground_truth.expected_answer: Agent_Context.md describing major major project thesis on ambient context engine.

queries.query: Which files was I editing in Antigravity IDE?

ground_truth.expected_answer: README.md, requirements.txt, Agent_Context.md, query_taxonomy.json, and Settings.

queries.query: What websites was I visiting on Google Chrome?

ground_truth.expected_answer: Claude AI, Google Search (Annotate), WhatsApp Web, and Ambient Context Engine.

queries.query: Find where I was looking at query_taxonomy.json

ground_truth.expected_answer: Captures 103-110 in Antigravity IDE viewing query_taxonomy.json.

categories.name: Hybrid (Temporal + Semantic)
categories.description: Queries combining temporal constraints with semantic content filters — the core thesis query type.

queries.query: What repo documentation was I reading around 9:53 PM on November 23?

ground_truth.expected_answer: Agent_Context.md and Preview Agent_Context.md in Antigravity IDE.

queries.query: What Claude conversation was I having in Chrome around 9:45 PM on November 23?

ground_truth.expected_answer: OmniContext Claude chat in Google Chrome.

queries.query: What search query did I perform in Chrome around 9:43 PM on November 23?

ground_truth.expected_answer: Annotate Google Search in Chrome.

queries.query: What file was open in Antigravity IDE between 9:42 PM and 9:45 PM on November 23?

ground_truth.expected_answer: requirements.txt in Antigravity IDE.

queries.query: Did I look at WhatsApp around 9:51 PM on November 23?

ground_truth.expected_answer: Yes, active on WhatsApp in Google Chrome from 21:50:56 to 21:51:26.

queries.query: Summarize what I did with Agent_Context.md between 9:50 PM and 9:56 PM on November 23

ground_truth.expected_answer: Viewing and editing Agent_Context.md and previewing markdown in Antigravity IDE.

categories.name: Ambiguous / Low-Confidence
categories.description: Queries where the system should refuse or express uncertainty due to lack of captured evidence.

queries.query: What did my colleague say about the project deadline on the call?

ground_truth.expected_answer: Refusal: No audio transcripts captured.

queries.query: What was I working on three months ago on August 15th?

ground_truth.expected_answer: Refusal: Data retention / earliest capture is September 5th.

queries.query: Why was I reading WhatsApp messages at 9:50 PM?

ground_truth.expected_answer: Refusal: Internal intent cannot be inferred from screen captures.

queries.query: What will I be coding tomorrow morning at 10 AM?

ground_truth.expected_answer: Refusal: System cannot predict future activities.

queries.query: Did I finish all tasks planned for next month?

ground_truth.expected_answer: Refusal: Task completion status cannot be determined.

queries.query: What was displayed on my secondary screen when the power fluctuated?

ground_truth.expected_answer: Refusal: External physical event unobservable.
